g2_scope: SQL/chart family: duplicate dialect/format naming and illustrative Vega-Lite keys. Preserve injected-data and transform result semantics.
g3_scope: One non-obvious relation: datasets map SQL aliases to integer Dataset IDs. Required object/type/minProperties are unchanged.
progression: Inspect all G0/G1 cells, including two repetitions for revenue/restock, before G2. G2 initially uses revenue/restock r1; extend to r2 if no treatment-specific degradation. Only then consider G3 with the same sequential gate. Preserve every attempt; no retries until pass. Stop or split a harmful layer.
coverage_limit: Exposure is distinct from invocation and actual parameter use. Unused parameters do not establish dispensability. Small samples screen mechanisms, not stable pass rates or causal token savings.
prior_validation: 44 existing tests, pdm run check and pdm run smoke --isolated passed on this unchanged production baseline; no new automated tests.
